signals.text: Logo reads 'Brooks Development', main video won't load, leftover template text in the footer
Competitor Wilson & Cole shows 5.0 from 28 Google reviews up top

bestTime: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm

sections.label: Before you dial
sections.body:
Who: Don, director at Brook Developments, Bristol.
Why them: his site has real faults: the logo reads 'Brooks Development', the main video won't load, and there's leftover template text. I emailed him last week.
Best time: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm.
Ltd company: tick CTPS (and TPS if it's a personal mobile) in the desk before you dial.
What you want: a 15-minute phone or video call. They're not local, so no pop-in.
Stand up, slow down on your name, and stop talking after every question.

sections.label: If someone else answers
sections.body:
Hi, it's Dean Finlayson, is Don about?
_(if they ask what it's about)_ It's about how folk find Brook Developments online. Is Don the right person for that, or is it someone else?
_(if Don is out)_ No bother. When's the best time to catch them? _(write their name in the note)_

sections.label: Opener
sections.body:
Hi Don, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One up in Scotland. _(slow)_
I emailed you last week about a few things on your website. Is now OK for 30 seconds?
_(stop and wait)_

sections.label: Why I'm calling
sections.body:
Your renovation reviews are great. One client said you went far beyond what they expected. But the website lets you down. The logo says Brooks Development, the main video won't load, and there's leftover template text in the footer.
_(if they say go on)_ How much of your work comes from people looking you up first?

sections.label: Questions
sections.body:
Q: Who looks after the website for you just now?
Q: When did someone last try it on their phone, start to finish?
Q: Do you get many enquiries through it, or is it mostly calls?
Listen for: nobody looking after the site, enquiries drying up, a phone call they didn't get.

sections.label: If it's a problem for them
sections.body:
That's what I do. I'll send you a short list of the three to five things I'd fix first, with screenshots. You can fix them yourself, or I'll do it. Either way it's yours to keep.
I build it all myself, so you deal with me start to finish.

sections.label: The ask
sections.body:
Easier to show you than explain. Fifteen minutes on the phone, or a video call if that's easier. Tuesday at 8, or Thursday after 5, which is better?
_(if they hesitate)_ No commitment. If it's not for you, no bother at all.

sections.label: If they push back
sections.body:
They: Somebody already does our website.
You: Good, then the list will make their life easy. It's just the things I'd fix first. Want me to send it over?

They: I'm not interested.
You: Fair enough, most folk aren't till they know why I'm calling. Quick one before I go: is getting found online something you've got covered?

They: Send me an email.
You: Will do. So I don't send you something you'll bin, what matters more to you right now, more enquiries or less time on the phone?

They: How much is it?
You: Depends what you need. It's a one-off build and then a small monthly. I'd rather show you first than throw a number at you. Fifteen minutes on the phone this week?

They: Don't call me again.
You: No problem, I'll take you off. Sorry for the interruption, all the best. _(Log as Do not call)_
